components.verdict: So we trial it, with limits, measures and stop rules set first

footnote: Source: Fan et al. 2025. Autonomy et al. 2023, 2024. Gomes et al. 2024. Münster 2026. Brazil pilot 2024. InfoMoney 2025. Krystal 2023
notes: Put the two sides together. What holds up: staff health really did improve, most firms that finished chose to continue, and firms that changed how they work were more likely to stick with it. What to watch: revenue did not rise because of it, the pressure moved from hours to intensity, customer support and always-on roles are the hardest, and some firms drop out over time. The evidence supports a trial with limits, measures and the means to stop. It does not support the claim that one day less brings more revenue. That is how we will run it.
